#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Shebang + argparse CLI without an explicit __main__ guard."""

import argparse


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="run")
    parser.add_argument("--msg", default="ok")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(args.msg)


main()
